notes.title: Another update
notes.notes: Worked on the map and worked on the vendor shopkeeper and some player shop mechanics

notes.title: Huge update
notes.notes:
A short list of what awaits you in the new update:

* Footstep system was updated
* Building system was updated 
* Fishing System (fishing rod, worms, new logic)
* Advanced starting customisation / 
* Advanced AI Improvements (a huge amount of work, more details after the release)
* AI Companions (system of orders, joining in a group, reworked archers and shooters, new behavior trees and so on)
* New characters with unique behaviours (hen, rooster, chick, pig, swine, piglet) & advanced new logic
* Farming system (quite a complex system, in which we put our heart and soul). You will be able to grow animals
* New building objects: fences, high walls, gates, spiked walls, coops, feeders and so on. Most of the new buildings have animations and new extra logic. Water Storage, with placeholder logic for now. 



* We also fixed various bugs that you found and reported!

The update will be available sometime in mid-summer (September). Maybe sooner, maybe.

* With this big update there will be a little price increase .

Thank you for your time and patience!

LC Development

notes.title: Update pushed back
notes.notes: The update has been pushed back until the 15th due to technical problems. Our team is working hard to push the update. The update is going really well. Look forward to your feedback and thank you for you patience.

notes.title: Future Update
notes.notes:
A new update will be launched at the beginning of next month. Our Devs are working hard on fixing known issues and adding additional content.
Reworking farming systems and adding additional resources.
Adding animals and the ability to breed and feed livestock.
Reworking electrical components and power systems.
Additional tools will also be added to the crafting menu.

Our discord link has been updated and added to the store page. 

Thanks for you patience and looking forward to hearing your reviews.
